Preserve her proportions, outfit, silhouette and melancholy expression. Authored pixel-art cels with clean discrete pixel clusters, NOT concept illustration. Transparent background with real alpha preferred; if not possible use uniform bright key-green #00ff00. No text, frames, guides, scenery, glows or shadows. Grid exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, 12 isolated full-body sprites, centered in equal cells with generous padding. Same character size and baseline in every cell; each is a distinct drawn animation pose, not a rotated copy. All face RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Frames in reading order: 1-8 a continuous walking cycle, alternating clearly visible forward/back legs and arms with subtly swinging skirt and hair. Frames 9-12 a floating-follow loop: knees bent softly with feet off the ground, skirt hanging, hair lifting in a gentle upward draft, hands held close to chest, small changes in head and arms. Fully clothed, tranquil but subtly unnatural. Readable body and face at 48 pixels tall.
